meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Spain (unitary national jurisdiction; Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada with mandatory notarial deed of incorporation and registration in the Registro Mercantil)

Convention between the Kingdom of Spain and the People's Republic of China for the Avoidance of Double Taxation and the Prevention of Fiscal Evasion with Respect to Taxes on Income and Capital (signed 22 November 1990; in force since 21 May 1992)

Spain-Panama Bilateral Investment Treaty (signed 16 November 1994; in force since 1 July 1997)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 10/2010, de 28 de abril, de prevención del blanqueo de capitales y de la financiación del terrorismo, as amended by Real Decreto-ley 7/2021 (transposing Directive (EU) 2018/843, AMLD5) and Real Decreto-ley 12/2022; implementing regulation Real Decreto 304/2014, de 5 de mayo; UBO register obligations under Real Decreto 95/2021, de 23 de febrero (Registro de Titularidades Reales del Ministerio de Justicia) and the unified UBO record regime introduced by Ley 6/2023; foreign investment and capital-movement screening under Ley 19/2003, de 4 de julio; notarial and registry duties under Ley 14/2013 (entrepreneur support) and Reglamento del Registro Mercantil (Real Decreto 1784/1996).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation and current Articles of Association of the direct foreign corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: State Administration for Market Regulation of the People's Republic of China / provincial or municipal Market Supervision Bureau
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China or designated provincial Foreign Affairs Office (PRC accession effective for Spain since 7 November 2023), followed by sworn Spanish translation by a traductor jurado

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / Certificate of Active Legal Status of the direct foreign corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: State Administration for Market Regulation of the People's Republic of China / competent commercial registration office
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (PRC competent authority) plus sworn Spanish translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Passport bio-page and proof of residential address of each individual UBO, director, and authorized signatory
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National passport authority and municipal or police registration authority of the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarial attestation followed by Hague Apostille for documentation issued in the People's Republic of China, or consular legalization for non-Hague issuers, plus sworn Spanish translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Special Power of Attorney authorizing the incorporation of the Spanish SL and execution of the escritura pública de constitución
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the jurisdiction of the foreign shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille by the competent notarial authority, sworn Spanish translation, and physical presentation of the original to the Spanish notary at deed execution

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and source-of-funds evidence covering the statutory minimum share capital and initial project working capital
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed credit institution in the country of origin of the funds
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarial certification and Hague Apostille or consular legalization (if non-Hague jurisdiction), with supporting KYC documentation subject to SEPBLAC review

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-incorporation screening of all UBOs, directors, and authorized signatories against domestic and international lists, specifically: (i) SEPBLAC alerts and Spanish tax agency (AEAT) risk registers; (ii) the EU consolidated financial sanctions list under Council Regulation (EU) No 269/2014 and Council Regulation (EU) No 2580/2001; (iii) UN Security Council consolidated sanctions; (iv) the OFAC SDN list for all USD-denominated Swift wires; and (v) judicial and administrative disqualification orders published in the Boletín Oficial del Estado. Enhanced due diligence is mandatory for any politically exposed person resident in Spain or the European Union, for high-risk third-country nationals, and for any match with media or open-source sanctions alerts; the written screening results must be retained and produced to the notary and, upon request, to SEPBLAC.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Mercantil Central (RMC), Sección de Denominaciones Sociales, official electronic application 'Certificación de denominación social' at https://www.rmc.es; electronic incorporation may also be initiated through the CIRCE portal (Centro de Información y Red de Creación de Empresas) using the Documento Único Electrónico.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The proposed corporate name must be expressed in Latin (Roman) characters; Spanish diacritical marks and 'ñ' are permitted. Denomination may be formed in Spanish or in any official language of the European Union, but any foreign-language expression must be submitted with a Spanish transliteration or translation for the RMC certificate. The full name must incorporate the legal-form suffix 'Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada' or the abbreviation 'S.L.' (or 'S.L.U.' for a single-member company).
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Identical or phonetically and visually similar names to any existing Spanish company (corporate name exclusivity under arts. 406-408 of the Reglamento del Registro Mercantil)

'España', 'Estado', 'Nacional', 'Real', 'General', 'Ministerio', 'Gobierno', 'Administración', 'Consejo', 'Ayuntamiento', 'Diputación', 'Municipio', 'Comunidad Autónoma' and any token suggesting official public authority, requiring prior authorization of the competent ministerial or autonomous-community body or otherwise barred

'Banco', 'Caja', 'Seguros', 'Reaseguros', 'Fondos', 'Sociedad de Valores', 'Gestora de Capital Riesgo' and any term referring to reserved financial, insurance, or securities activities requiring prior Banco de España or Comisión Nacional del Mercado de Valores authorization
Terms contrary to law, public order, or morality, and any denomination that may induce public confusion as to the true corporate purpose, territorial scope, or regulated status of the company
Personal names of third parties without the individual's express notarized consent
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon issuance of a negative name certificate or a rejection by the RMC, the applicant may: (1) file a written reconsideration request (recurso de reposición) before the Registro Mercantil Central within one month of notification, attaching a revised alternative name list; (2) bring the matter before the Dirección General de Seguridad Jurídica y Fe Pública by means of the administrative channel (procedimiento gubernativo) if the reconsideration is denied; and (3) where the administrative remedies are exhausted, file a contentious-administrative appeal (recurso contencioso-administrativo) before the Juzgado de lo Contencioso-Administrativo in Madrid within two months of final rejection. The applicant may simultaneously file a fresh name-clearance application with up to five alternative denominations because the reservation is not suspended pending appeal. A valid positive certificate (certificación negativa de denominación) must be delivered to the notary and incorporated into the deed within its 90-day validity period; an expired certificate requires a new application.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible only as a formal correspondence address for the registered office during the initial organizational period, provided that a dedicated physical technical and operational office in Spain is established within the first financial year. A pure letterbox arrangement would jeopardize the mandatory railway-sector contractor license under Ley 38/2015, de 29 de septiembre, del Sector Ferroviario, the construction-activity authorizations required for ISIC 4210/NAICS 237990 works, and would trigger a rebuttal of Spanish corporate tax residence and an AEAT substance audit. The Spanish notary will require evidence of real control over the domicile at deed execution, and the registrador may reject the inscription if the address lacks credible substance.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Moderate-to-heightened for a licensed rail-infrastructure EPC contractor: approximately 35% probability of an unannounced physical inspection by the Registro Mercantil, AEAT, SEPBLAC, or the competent transport authority within the first 24 months of operation; the likelihood rises above 50% if the registered office is a shared coworking address without dedicated management and technical staff.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Positive name clearance certificate application (certificación de denominación social) at the Registro Mercantil Central
Legal review of proposed corporate name against RMC guidelines and preparation of three alternative name lists
Notarial incorporation deed (escritura pública de constitución), including statutory review of the by-laws by the notary
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff (Real Decreto 1426/1989 notarial arancel, share-capital-linked)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Sworn translation (traducción jurada) of three foreign corporate documents (certificate of incorporation, certificate of good standing, passport and address proof)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Sworn translator (traductor jurado) certified by the Spanish Ministry of Foreign Affairs

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Hague Apostille legalization of four origin-country dossiers (PRC Ministry of Foreign Affairs and provincial Foreign Affairs Offices)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China / provincial Foreign Affairs Offices

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Commercial Registry inscription fee (inscripción de la sociedad) at the competent Registro Mercantil
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registrador Mercantil / Colegio de Registradores de España

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO register declaration filing and corporate data preparation (Registro de Titularidades Reales / unified UBO record)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Spanish Commercial Registry / Ministry of Justice

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML-KYC and sanctions screening: PEP, OFAC, UN, and EU consolidated list checks on all UBOs, directors, and shareholders, including the written due-diligence report
Registered office service (virtual correspondence address with dedicated staff) for the first twelve months
Pre-incorporation legal retainer: by-law drafting, foreign-investment screening under Ley 19/2003, and government-bond escrow and Swift wire documentation
NIE (Número de Identidad de Extranjero) processing for foreign director and UBO, including consular application and criminal-record certification
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Spanish consulate / Dirección General de la Policía

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Bank certificate evidencing the paid-in statutory share capital (certificado de desembolso) issued by the Spanish credit institution holding the pre-incorporation escrow account

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Royal Legislative Decree 1/2010 approving the Spanish Companies Act (Ley de Sociedades de Capital), particularly Articles 4, 19-22, 23-24, 32, 36-40, 62, 78-79, 210-242, and 245-251; Royal Decree 1784/1996 approving the Commercial Registry Regulations; Law 14/2013 and related electronic incorporation procedures where applicable.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: The Commercial Registry (Registro Mercantil) of the province where the registered office is located, under the coordination of the Central Commercial Registry (Registro Mercantil Central).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Public deed of incorporation (escritura pública de constitución), including the articles of association, followed by registration with the competent Provincial Commercial Registry.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: A Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada may be incorporated with minimum share capital of EUR 1. Until the company reaches EUR 3,000 in capital, at least 20 percent of annual profit must be allocated to the legal reserve and, on liquidation, shareholders bear joint liability for the shortfall between EUR 3,000 and the subscribed capital. Capital contributions must be fully paid at incorporation. A bank deposit certificate is generally not required if the founders assume responsibility for the reality of the contributions in the deed; otherwise, a bank certificate may be provided. Spain has no general statutory escrow requirement.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: The Board resolves that the Company accept and record the subscription and full payment of its issued shares as stated in the incorporation deed and articles of association. The Board adopts the registered office at [full address] and authorizes its registration and use for all statutory and commercial purposes. The Board appoints [name] as sole director, or confirms the directors appointed in the incorporation deed, with the powers specified in the articles and applicable law. The officers are authorized to obtain the tax identification number, complete Commercial Registry filings, open bank accounts, and execute all documents required for commencement of business.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Reserve and Certify the Company Name
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Central Commercial Registry (Registro Mercantil Central), Name Certification Service
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the proposed name electronically or through an authorized filing agent. Obtain a negative name certificate confirming that the name is not identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered name. The certificate is generally valid for three months for execution of the incorporation deed and may be reserved for the statutory period applicable to registration.
required_dossiers: Proposed company names in ranked order
Power of attorney if filed by an agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected, submit alternative names or challenge only on the grounds and within the procedural period stated by the registry. Execute the deed before the certificate expires or obtain a renewed certificate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Prepare Corporate Documents and Foreign-Investor Evidence
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Spanish notary public and, where applicable, the Foreign Investment Registry of the Directorate-General for International Trade and Investment
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the articles of association, beneficial ownership information, management structure, corporate purpose, registered office, share capital, ownership percentages, and powers of representation. Obtain Spanish tax identification numbers for foreign shareholders, directors, and the company. Foreign public documents must be apostilled or legalized and translated into Spanish by a sworn translator unless an applicable exemption applies.
required_dossiers: Founder and director passports or national identity documents
Foreign shareholders' Spanish NIF or NIE numbers
Corporate certificates and powers of attorney for corporate shareholders
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct identification, translation, apostille, beneficial ownership, or corporate-authority deficiencies before signing. Replace defective powers of attorney or obtain supplemental notarial ratification.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Open the Capital Account and Fund the Shares
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Spanish credit institution selected by the founders
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a provisional account in the proposed company name and deposit the full subscribed capital. Obtain a deposit certificate where the founders elect to use one. Contributions in kind require identification and valuation in the deed; an SL generally does not require an independent expert report, but founders and contributors remain subject to statutory liability for the reality and value of contributions.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond to bank KYC or source-of-funds queries with ownership charts, tax identification, transaction rationale, and supporting financial records. If the bank declines onboarding, use another regulated Spanish credit institution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Arrange a notarial signing by all founders or duly authorized representatives. The deed must state the founders, intention to incorporate, contributions, share allocations, articles, management system, and initial directors. The notary verifies identity, authority, beneficial ownership, capital evidence or founder responsibility, and compliance with applicable legal formalities.
required_dossiers: Capital deposit certificate or statutory founder declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Cure notarial observations by correcting the draft, supplying missing evidence, or obtaining a supplemental deed. Do not submit an incomplete deed to the Commercial Registry.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain Tax Identification and Register the Company
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Spanish Tax Agency (Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria) and the Provincial Commercial Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for the provisional company NIF using Form 036 and submit the incorporation deed, then file the deed electronically or through the notary with the Provincial Commercial Registry. After registration, obtain the definitive NIF and update the Tax Agency. Register the beneficial ownership information and maintain the required corporate books, including the shareholders' register and minutes book.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry issues a qualification notice, correct the identified defect through a supplemental deed, rectification, or additional documentation and resubmit within the applicable statutory period. A registry decision may be appealed to the Directorate-General for Legal Certainty and Public Faith or challenged judicially.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Complete Operational, Social Security, and Contractor Registrations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Spanish Tax Agency, General Treasury of Social Security, relevant autonomous-community authority, municipality, and public contracting authorities
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the relevant census and business-activity registrations, register as an employer before hiring personnel, enroll employees in Social Security, and obtain municipal opening or activity authorization where premises are used. For public rail-transit EPC work, register or qualify as required for public procurement, obtain contractor classification where contract value and type require it, and satisfy project-specific railway, construction, safety, and environmental conditions.
required_dossiers: Public procurement registration and solvency evidence
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond to authority requests with corrected technical, solvency, safety, or premises documentation. Appeal procurement exclusion, licensing refusal, or administrative sanctions through the applicable administrative and judicial review procedures.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: The competent authority is normally the relevant autonomous-community industrial and energy department, together with the municipality and the Ministry of Transport and Sustainable Mobility where state railway infrastructure, railway safety, or public procurement functions are involved. Spain has no single nationwide industrial operating licence specifically titled for rail-transit EPC contractors.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Project-specific construction, activity, works, and commissioning authorizations; registration in the Integrated Industrial Register where an applicable regulated industrial activity is performed; public-works contractor classification or procurement qualification where required under Law 9/2017 on Public Sector Contracts; and railway safety authorizations or certificates where the company acts as a railway undertaking, infrastructure manager, or performs regulated safety-critical functions.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry for the Ecological Transition and the Demographic Challenge (Ministerio para la Transición Ecológica y el Reto Demográfico), or the competent environmental authority of the relevant autonomous community
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Project-specific screening under Law 21/2013 on Environmental Assessment. Full ordinary or simplified EIA may apply to new railway infrastructure, urban rail extensions, depots, substations, borrow areas, waste facilities, or materially affecting protected areas. Pure design, project-management, and off-site EPC services are generally not independently subject to EIA, although the underlying project remains subject to assessment.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Comply with the applicable integrated environmental authorization, waste legislation, water authority discharge permit, municipal activity permit, noise rules, and air-quality requirements. Industrial emissions, wastewater, VOCs, hazardous waste, contaminated soils, and construction waste are controlled by the applicable national, autonomous-community, and local permits; no single nationwide numeric threshold applies to every rail EPC activity. Waste must be segregated, transferred through authorized operators, documented, and managed under Law 7/2022 on Waste and Contaminated Soils.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Obtain municipal works and activity permits, fire-prevention approval or certificate where required by the premises and applicable building and fire codes, and technical certification for structural, electrical, lifting, pressure, and load-bearing systems where relevant. Implement Law 31/1995 on Occupational Risk Prevention, risk assessments, coordination of contractor activities, worker training, emergency planning, health surveillance, and site-specific safety plans. Railway works must also satisfy the infrastructure manager's technical, access, possession, electrical isolation, signaling, and construction-safety requirements.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT); Sede Electrónica — https://sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For the Spanish SL: obtain provisional NIF before inscription in the Mercantile Registry, file Form 036/037 to be registered in the territorial census of economic activities, then receive definitive NIF. For non-resident foreign limited companies engaging in transactions subject to Spanish VAT/withholding: file Form 036/037 to obtain the NIF assigned to non-residents (NIF-IE), appoint a tax/fiscal representative when no PE is established and the taxpayer is outside the EU/ETA or where so requested by AEAT, and use the Sede Electrónica for all electronic filings.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box election exists in Spanish tax law; an SL is mandatorily an opaque entity-level taxpayer. Elective regimes available: (a) consolidated tax group regime under Art. 64 LIS (approximately 90% capital links, optional group election); (b) ETVE (sociedad holding) special participation-exemption regime; (c) patent-box/R&D elections; (d) special simplified VAT regimes for SMEs; (e) hybrid mismatch elections are not available and EU-ATAD anti-hybrid rules (Art. 15 LIS) automatically reclassify dual-resident or hybrid instruments.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: IVA - Impuesto sobre el Valor Añadido (Spanish VAT)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable for domestic establishment: any taxable person habitually carrying out supplies of goods/services in Spanish territory must register prior to operations; a foreign supplier crossing the intra-EU distance-sales threshold (EUR 10,000 of annual cross-border distance sales of goods into Spain) or otherwise making domestic taxable supplies acquires Spanish VAT registration obligations.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No general real-time pre-clearance or digital stamping regime applies to all Spanish invoices. Mandates are phased: all billing systems must be Verifactu-compatible under RD 1007/2023 ensuring integrity, traceability and issuance of a QR/hash code; B2B electronic invoicing is mandatory in accordance with Law 18/2022 (large issuers within one year of royal decree trigger and all other business within two years). Large taxpayers with turnover above EUR 6 million are subject to SII (Immediate Supply of Information), requiring near-real-time electronic reporting of all invoice records to AEAT through authenticated web services/API, generally within 4 calendar days of issue; failure to submit via the required XML/TLS schema is an informatics-infraction penalty.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods: exports to non-EU destinations may be zero-rated/exempt under Art. 21 LIVA only if title passes to a non-EU customer and physical dispatch or transport outside the EU customs territory is documented, generally within the regulatory three-month period; the supplier must hold full documentary evidence. Services: transport, ancillary services, and work/treatment on movable goods subsequently exported to a non-EU destination are also zero-rated where used directly in export; other services are generally place-of-supply taxed unless invoiced to a non-established entrepreneur under B2B rules or where LIVA exempts them for international trade. The supplier must retain export declarations, transport documents, invoice, payment proof and, if applicable, inward remittance evidence; refunds are credited through the export section of the VAT return.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (DUA/SAD) electronically validated by Spanish Customs and AEAT
Bill of Lading (or CMR/AWB equivalent) showing actual dispatch to a non-EU destination
Commercial invoice with Incoterms and non-EU customer identification
Packing list and, where required, Certificate of Origin/EUR.1 or Invoice Declaration
Inward Remittance Certificate or SWIFT/bank documentary proof of receipt of export proceeds from the non-EU purchaser
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: AEAT may examine export proof within a four-year limitation period; failure to substantiate the exit of goods or payment brings the exported supplies back into taxable scope at 21% IVA, plus late-payment interest and graduated penalties (50% to 150% of the tax due) under Articles 183/184/191 LGT. The taxpayer also loses any associated input VAT deduction and is required to repay refunds. Where the export documentation is falsified or the zero-rating is obtained fraudulently, AEAT assesses a tax fraud penalty and, if the evaded amount exceeds EUR 120,000, Criminal Law Article 305 (Organic Law 10/1995, as amended) exposes individual managers to imprisonment and to a monetary penalty of six times the defrauded amount.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de España, operating within the Eurosystem under the monetary policy authority of the European Central Bank. Foreign-exchange and foreign-investment reporting is also administered under Spanish Ministry of Economy, Trade and Enterprise regulations.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Spain uses the euro and has full current-account convertibility and generally unrestricted capital-account convertibility under the EU Treaty, EU capital-movement rules, and Spanish Law 19/2003 on the legal regime of capital movements and economic transactions abroad. An SL may generally receive foreign capital, convert currencies, hold foreign-currency accounts, pay non-resident suppliers, and remit dividends, interest, royalties, loan principal, and liquidation proceeds, subject to corporate-law approvals, withholding-tax rules, beneficial-owner verification, sanctions screening, transfer-pricing requirements, and applicable foreign-investment reporting. Prior authorization or post-closing notification may apply to certain foreign investments in strategic sectors, including specified transport and critical-infrastructure activities. A rail-transit EPC contractor should distinguish its construction-services activity from ownership or control of regulated infrastructure assets.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Spain has no general statutory requirement to surrender export proceeds to a Spanish bank, no general mandatory conversion ratio, and no general statutory deadline requiring conversion of export receipts into euros. Export proceeds may generally be retained in foreign currency or abroad, subject to contractual, accounting, tax, AML, sanctions, and reporting obligations. The company must retain commercial and transport evidence, reconcile invoices and collections, record foreign-currency transactions under Spanish accounting rules, and provide information requested by its bank, Banco de España, customs authorities, tax authorities, or statistical reporting systems. Sectoral, financing, public-procurement, grant, or project-account terms may impose stricter cash-location or currency requirements.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account; project collection account; bank-guarantee and escrow capability subject to mandate
Operational Account; foreign-currency account; trade-finance and project-banking capability
Operational Account; public-sector and project-finance account; guarantee and collection services
Operational Account; SME treasury account; trade-finance and guarantee capability
Operational Account; guarantee, payment, and domestic project-account capability
Operational Account; foreign-currency payments; guarantees and trade-finance capability

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium for payment execution and collections, but low as a sole treasury bank for a rail-transit EPC business. An EU-authorized electronic-money institution or payment institution may provide payment accounts, international transfers, foreign exchange, and safeguarding services, including through passporting. It is not a credit institution unless separately licensed; safeguarded customer funds are not ordinary bank deposits and may not benefit from the Spanish deposit-guarantee scheme. Public-procurement escrow, bid bonds, performance guarantees, construction guarantees, cash collateral, complex ownership structures, large project receipts, and high-value cross-border payments may require a regulated bank. Verify the provider on the Banco de España or relevant EEA supervisory register and confirm licensing, safeguarding, sanctions controls, transaction limits, and account-closure rights.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Spanish law does not impose a universal requirement for directors to appear physically to open a corporate bank account. Remote onboarding may be permitted where the bank accepts reliable electronic identification, qualified electronic signatures, video identification, or notarized and apostilled documentation. Banks may nevertheless require an in-person meeting, branch visit, live video interview, Spanish tax-resident representative, or original documents for non-resident shareholders, complex ownership, public-sector contracts, high-risk jurisdictions, foreign-source capital, or unusual transaction activity. The SL should maintain a Spanish registered office, Spanish tax identification number, Registro Mercantil extract, verified ultimate-beneficial-owner records, and appropriately empowered signatories.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Incomplete or inconsistent ownership chain, unidentified ultimate beneficial owner, nominee shareholder, or ownership held through multiple offshore entities
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified company registry extracts for every ownership-layer entity; constitutional documents; shareholder register; ownership chart to natural-person beneficial owners; passports and proof of address; beneficial-owner declaration; board resolutions; and written explanation of commercial rationale.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Foreign shareholder or director documents not legalized, apostilled, translated, or consistent with Spanish registry information
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Recent apostilled or legally legalized corporate certificates; sworn Spanish translations where required; notarized powers of attorney; Spanish Registro Mercantil documentation; tax identification numbers; and a reconciliation memorandum identifying any name, address, or date discrepancy.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Large inbound shareholder loan or capital contribution without an identifiable source of wealth and source of funds
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed capital-increase or loan agreement; bank statements showing originating funds; audited financial statements of the funding entity; tax returns or financial records; board approvals; beneficial-owner wealth evidence; intercompany pricing support; and payment-purpose instructions.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Rail-transit EPC activity involving government bodies, public tenders, infrastructure assets, politically exposed persons, or commission-based intermediaries
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Tender notice and award documents; public-contract register evidence; ultimate-customer identification; contract, bill of quantities, and payment schedule; anti-bribery policy; intermediary due-diligence file; beneficial-owner and PEP screening; sanctions screening; conflict-of-interest declarations; and documented approval controls.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-value or unusual cross-border payments to jurisdictions, suppliers, agents, or beneficiaries inconsistent with the stated EPC business
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Underlying invoice; purchase order; signed contract; shipping, delivery, or engineering evidence; supplier registry records; tax documentation; customs records where relevant; sanctions screening results; bank account ownership confirmation; and an internal transaction-monitoring narrative.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Expected activity materially higher than the newly incorporated SL's financial statements, staffing, contracts, or operating footprint
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Three-year cash-flow forecast; awarded or near-award project contracts; financing commitments; consortium or subcontractor agreements; payroll and operational budget; beneficial-owner funding plan; expected monthly transaction matrix; and written explanation of project milestones and peak-payment periods.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Use of personal accounts, cash settlements, third-party payment instructions, cryptoasset sources, or unexplained payment-account changes
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Formal treasury policy; prohibition of personal and cash settlement; approved beneficiary register; dual-authorization matrix; invoice-to-payment reconciliation; source-of-funds evidence; payment-change call-back controls; and documented rejection of unsupported third-party instructions.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions, export-control, dual-use, or restricted-party exposure connected with rail equipment, signaling, telecommunications, power systems, or foreign counterparties
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Product classification; end-user and end-use certificates; supplier and customer screening; EU and UN sanctions review; export-license analysis; shipping-route review; contractual sanctions clauses; and compliance-officer approval.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Route shareholder equity, share-premium funding, and shareholder loans through an account held in the SL's legal name at a Spanish credit institution. Use a complete payment narrative identifying the legal entity, funding instrument, project, and purpose; avoid unexplained third-party remitters. For equity, coordinate the capital increase, notarial deed where applicable, Registro Mercantil filing, bank certificate of funds, and accounting entry. For shareholder loans, retain the executed agreement, maturity, interest, repayment terms, transfer-pricing support, and any required corporate approvals. The bank may request foreign-investment declarations or information under Spanish foreign-investment rules, particularly where the investor is non-EU or the activity involves strategic transport or critical infrastructure. There is no universal Spanish FX purpose-code regime equivalent to a mandatory Chinese-style code system; banks may require internal payment-purpose categories, ISO 20022 remittance information, LEI or tax identifiers, and supporting documents. Use SEPA Credit Transfer for euro payments within SEPA and SWIFT or correspondent-bank transfers for non-SEPA or foreign-currency payments. Maintain a full audit trail from funding authorization to receipt, conversion, and use.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Use SEPA Credit Transfer or SEPA Instant Credit Transfer for eligible euro payments and SWIFT cross-border transfers for non-SEPA currencies. SWIFT MT103 remains a commonly recognized customer-payment format, while ISO 20022 pacs.008 is increasingly used through bank migration and correspondent channels. For equipment procurement, use documentary Commercial Letters of Credit subject to UCP 600, preferably confirmed where counterparty or country risk warrants it. Use documentary collections under URC 522 where a lower-cost structure is acceptable, and bank guarantees or demand guarantees under URDG 758 for advance-payment, performance, retention, or warranty obligations. Match each payment to an approved contract, purchase order, invoice, beneficiary verification, sanctions screening result, tax treatment, and delivery or milestone evidence. For public-sector project receipts, establish a segregated project collection account or contractually defined escrow only where required by the employer, financing documents, or procurement terms; Spanish law does not automatically require a generic government-bond escrow account for every EPC company.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable foreign-exchange forwards for forecast or contracted receivables and payables, subject to bank suitability, documentation, collateral, and accounting controls
Currency swaps and cross-currency interest-rate swaps for multi-period funding or committed cash-flow exposures, normally documented under an ISDA Master Agreement with appropriate collateral terms
Non-deliverable forwards for currencies that are non-convertible or operationally unsuitable for physical delivery, subject to bank product availability and applicable local-market rules

Foreign-exchange options and collars for protected exchange-rate floors or caps, subject to MiFID II classification, product governance, suitability or appropriateness requirements, and clear premium disclosure
Exchange-traded or centrally cleared currency futures where liquidity and hedge-accounting objectives justify standardized contracts
Natural hedging through currency matching of project receipts, supplier payments, debt service, and subcontractor obligations

Hedging must be linked to identifiable commercial or financing exposures, recorded under the treasury policy, approved under delegated authority, screened for counterparty risk, and evaluated under EU EMIR, MiFID II, accounting, collateral, and applicable bank documentation requirements

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Legalisation of corporate books (Libro Diario, Libro de Inventarios y Cuentas Anuales) for the previous fiscal year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registro Mercantil Provincial (Commercial Registry of the registered office province)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 4 months after fiscal year-end; for 31 December year-end, by 30 April
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late legalisation impairs evidentiary value of accounting books and triggers fines from the Commercial Registry; refusal to accept subsequent filings until regularised.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Deposit of Annual Accounts (Depósito de Cuentas Anuales: balance sheet, profit and loss account, statement of changes in equity, and management report)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registro Mercantil Provincial (Commercial Registry of the registered office province)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Shareholders' approval within 6 months after fiscal year-end; deposit with the Registry within 1 month after approval; for 31 December year-end, deposit by 31 July
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing triggers cierre registral (registry closure), fines up to EUR 2,000, and administrative strike-off after two consecutive non-filings.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Return (Impuesto sobre Sociedades)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 25 days following the 6-month period after tax year-end; for calendar-year taxpayers, by 25 July
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing surcharge of 5% to 20% depending on delay, plus late-payment interest; 50% surcharge reduction if voluntarily regularised before AEAT notification.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Third-Party Transaction Reporting (Modelo 347) when transactions with an individual counterparty exceed EUR 3,005.06
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For calendar-year taxpayers, 1–20 February of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines for omission or inaccuracy of EUR 100–EUR 10,000, plus proportional penalties up to 1% of affected transaction volume.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Confirmation of Ultimate Beneficial Owner Register (Declaration of UBO status and updates on shareholding transfers)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registro Mercantil Provincial (administered alongside the annual accounts deposit)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Same window as annual accounts deposit; for 31 December year-end, by 31 July
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file a truthful declaration may constitute administrative infringement under Spanish AML Law, with fines up to EUR 60,000 for serious breaches.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Independent statutory audit is mandatory if, for two consecutive fiscal years, the SL meets at least two of the following: (a) total assets exceed EUR 2,850,000; (b) net turnover exceeds EUR 5,700,000; (c) average number of employees exceeds 50. Audit also mandatory if the SL is a public-interest entity, belongs to a group required to consolidate, or is expressly required by shareholders or the Articles of Association.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Individual annual accounts must be prepared under Spanish GAAP (Plan General de Contabilidad), harmonised with EU accounting directives; consolidated financial statements, where applicable, must follow EU-IFRS under Regulation (EC) No 1606/2002.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The SL administrator must maintain an internal UBO register, update it within each calendar year, and provide an annual written confirmation to the general shareholders' meeting. The UBO confirmation is filed with the Registro Mercantil as an annex to the annual accounts deposit, expressly stating any changes resulting from share transfers or changes in ownership control during the preceding year.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Libro Registro de Socios)
Accounting and Inventory Books (Libro de Inventarios y Cuentas Anuales)

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 25% headline rate; incentives include accelerated depreciation (up to 200% for R&D), investment deductions, and regional tax relief for infrastructure projects

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Modelo 100 (Corporate Income Tax Return) via AEAT electronic filing portal
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: By the last day of the fourth month following fiscal year-end (e.g., 30 April for calendar year-end)

field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report Spanish-source income attributable to the permanent establishment; non-residents file via Modelo 100 with WHT credit claims
Apply 25% rate to taxable base; non-residents may offset foreign taxes via treaty relief

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: 100-600 EUR base penalty plus 10-20% of tax due; daily surcharge 0.1% of tax (max 60 days); criminal sanctions for evasion

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Submit TRC (Treaty Relief Certificate) application to AEAT via electronic portal with ownership proof, beneficial ownership declaration, and supporting documentation; approval required prior to payment to claim reduced rate
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: 19% statutory rate, reduced to 0-10% under most treaties (e.g., EU, US, China); Interest: 19% statutory rate, reduced to 0% under bilateral treaties (e.g., EU, OECD Model)

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: 20 million EUR annual turnover threshold for mandatory Local File and Master File
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) apply; Spanish entity must demonstrate adequate economic substance including core income-generating activities, qualified employees, and premises in Spain

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Falsification of accounts or deliberate omission of taxable income
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal penalties: up to 5 years imprisonment and fines up to 3x evaded tax amount
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Piercing the corporate veil; directors face personal criminal liability, restitution orders, and possible imprisonment or travel bans

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining Spanish entity without sufficient local substance for tax residency or operations
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Denial of tax benefits, back-tax assessments, and penalties up to 50% of undeclared income
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Civil and criminal liability; potential disqualification from management roles and asset recovery actions

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to prepare or implement arm's length TP documentation or apply OECD principles
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative fines up to 5 million EUR or 10% of annual turnover; mandatory TP adjustments and interest charges
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal administrative fines and potential criminal liability for willful non-compliance
